the success of our risk management strategies

statements.t: “We continue to advance our organic growth backlog, with $2 billion of projects now commercialized . ”

“Our second quarter performance keeps us firmly on track to meet our financial goals for 2026 and we are reaffirming our 2026 Adjusted EBITDA guidance of $1.155 to $1.225 billion and our 2027 Adjusted EBITDA early outlook range of $1.225 to $1.295 billion,” said Jeff Jewell, Executive Vice President and CFO.

Additionally, because Adjusted EBITDA and DCF exclude some, but not all, items that affect net income and are defined differently by different companies in our industry, Adjusted EBITDA and DCF do not intend to represent net income attributable to DT Midstream, the most comparable GAAP measure, as an indicator of operating performance and are not necessarily comparable to similarly titled measures reported by…
